title: PEX vs Copper Pipes: Pros, Cons, and Practical Use in Residential Plumbing

locations.name: Northern urbanized areas (copper commonly used)
locations.basis: Transcript explicitly states copper remains common in northern urbanized areas

summary: This Old House hosts discuss PEX and copper piping, framing copper as the long-standing, rigid standard with lead-free solder and proven reliability, while presenting PEX as a flexible, coil-delivered alternative that can be run like wiring and fitted with fewer interior connections. The speakers acknowledge both materials have a place depending on application, with PEX gaining popularity in many regions and copper still favored in remodeling and around shower valves. The conversation also covers practical considerations such as tooling, fittings costs, and the way each material changes the skill set required for installation.
